title: Create: Orrery
description: A way to add northstar planets using datapacks into the game!
body:
# Create: Orrery

A data-driven planet addon for **Create: Northstar Redux**, expanding your solar system with new, explorable worlds.

Orrery builds on top of Northstar's rocket and survival mechanics, introducing a flexible, data-driven framework to add custom celestial bodies. Every new world defines its own gravity, atmosphere, temperature, and resources, fully integrating with Northstar's core systems (telescopes, rockets, life support, and more).

---

## ✨ Features

* **Data-Driven Worlds:** A robust `PlanetData` registry system allowing planets, gravity, skies, and fall-damage scaling to be configured easily.
* **Telescope Alignment:** Seamless integration into Northstar's telescope tracking system, including built-in fixes for sky rendering bugs.
* **Curated Surface Generation:** Immersive landscapes designed to feel alien. Overworld structures (villages, igloos) are cleaned out, while mod-compat resources (like AE2 meteorites) still generate.
* **New Tools & Resources:** Custom ore variants and tool-tier progressions mapped to the harsh environments of deep space.

---

## 🪐 Explorable Celestial Bodies


### 🧊 Pluto
The famous Kuiper Belt dwarf planet.
* **Environment:** Ultra-thin, deep black sky casting sharp, alien shadows. 
* **Gravity:** Roughly **6% of Earth's gravity**—even more floaty than Eris.
* **Surface:** A freezing wasteland composed of nitrogen ice sheets and water-ice mountains.

### 🌑 Eris
The distant, freezing dwarf planet located in the scattered disc.
* **Environment:** A pitch-black, star-filled sky with a faint, dim Sun. No atmosphere.
* **Gravity:** Roughly **8% of Earth's gravity** (~0.084g)—expect massive, floating jumps and delayed fall damage.
* **Surface:** Covered in moon sand and stone, featuring deposits of Copper, Zinc, Tungsten, and Titanium.

## 📋 Requirements & Compatibility

To run Create: Orrery, you will need:
* **Minecraft:** 1.21.1
* **Loader:** NeoForge
* **Dependencies:** [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create) & [Create: Northstar Redux](https://modrinth.com/mod/northstar-redux)

---

## ⚠️ Development Status

This mod is currently in **early development**. Features, planet stats, and generation rules may change between updates.
